business_delta: From accepted C10.var02 three-crew operational-failure input, attach CREW-DAY ShiftProfile 7-10, set Control.DRAOS=N and ResourceStationData.SHPID=CREW-DAY. ShiftResource schedules either all three allocated P-CREW or only two, leaving one off shift. The paired children differ only in ShiftResource.QTY 3 versus 2, aside from description; RMTBF=0.5, RMDT=0.25, seed 1, two half-hour preparations at 7.5, mission and 36-hour horizon remain unchanged.
pre_run_hypothesis: If a resource fails while both scheduled crew are performing preparation in the two-on-shift child, the third allocated but off-shift crew may replace it and allow both tasks to continue. The three-on-shift control has one idle on-shift spare. Shift construction or stochastic timing may prevent an informative failure; then retain raw runs as diagnostics only. Native events and resource capacity, task, mission, system, stock and terminal ledgers determine the bounded conclusion; individual crew identity may remain unobservable.

guarded serial session-0 SSH native runs preserving GUI PID 13340

limitations: One seed and one 7-10 shift with RMTBF=0.5 and RMDT=0.25 on the installed executable.
The log identifies a P-CREW pool, not individual workers; replacement may be inferred only at pool level.
Other shift patterns, off-shift policy outside this window, GUI visual behavior and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
